notes.title: Receiver v10: Modifiers Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29899/Wolfire_Franchise/

Receivers!

The Threat has once again invaded The Dreaming and expanded its grip on the world. To counter this, the Receivers are reaching out to you to support and give you more power and control of your Reality.

We are thrilled to announce a new update for Receiver, just in time for a sale on all of our titles and additions of new bundles. Support Wolfire in its goal to create more games and exciting content by checking them out!

This update brings some exciting changes and improvements to the game, including a new Modifier system that allows you change the gameplay in some fun ways. We’ve also fixed a set of performance issues and bugs, in particular one bug that had a major impact on Linux performance.

We’ve also added support for custom seeds, allowing you to replay the same world again, or share the seed with your friends to challenge each other.

We would love to hear suggestions for future modifiers in our Steam community or our Discord server.

New Modifiers

 Green Demon: try to complete the game while being chased by a slower but immortal kill drone.
 Thick Fog: Darken the world and shorten your view distance, making enemies harder to see and increasing their potential to surprise you.
 Spawn Magazines: At long last, additional magazines will spawn in the world, allowing you to have more than the ones you initially manifest.
 Tough Killdrones: Killdrones take more of a beating by requiring that you hit vital components, no more random chance of destruction by any hit.
 Deadly Threat: Everything is worse. The Threat is made near impossible to overcome.

Other Changes and Fixes

 Add a “Modifiers” menu button to play custom games.
 Reduce garbage generation in Shell Casings scripts.
 Fixed an issue with Revolvers.
 Made VSync turn off by default.
 Improved the Settings menu to be nicer to use and interact with.
 Implement FOV Slider.
 Stop limiting the games FPS to 60.
 Globally enable round interpolation inside of magazines.
 Adjust player camera near-plane.
 Implement a speedrun split timer for tape-pickup.
 Added an advertisement for Receiver 2 in the pause menu, can be completely disabled via settings.

notes.title: Update! Keybindings and Resolution Settings Are Back!
notes.content:
We've update Receiver to get some long-requested features back since they were originally disabled with the Unity engine upgrade.


 Switched to the new Unity Input system, with it comes the ability to more easily rebind inputs, which there's now a menu for
 Added quality and resolution settings to the in-game menu
 Made improvements that should positively effect performance for longer runs
 Fixed the full auto mode on the Glock is now functional again
 Updated the Unity Engine to version 2019.4.15f1

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
We just released a minor update to Receiver improving the mod experience, fixing rendering issues on MacOSX and some other quality of life improvements.


 Made chambering execute after slide lock
 Eject rounds if a magazine is ejected and a round is still loading
 Upgrade from Unity 2019.4.1f1 to Unity 2019.4.8f1 
 Default Mac build to OpenGL renderer instead of Metal, which fixes some rendering artefacts on mac.
 New radio buttons for setting Steam item visibility.
 Improved error handling for incompatible mods
 Default item visibility to public when uploading or updating mods
 Removed the stance requirement for the Gewehr98
 Display how many mods are being loaded right now
 Print the starting weapon and print mod enabled state
 Fadeout slomo warning the same way as start info
 Display current weapon for the first 5 seconds of a round
 Made it possible to change help text opacity

notes.title: Receiver 2019 Update
notes.content:
About
We just released a brand new update for Receiver! There have been *many* improvements to the engine since we launched the game that we wanted to take advantage of, especially with regards to performance. This update should also fix a few annoying little bugs and make the game look a bit nicer overall.

Update Video
[previewyoutube=tjLzRznghiI;full][/previewyoutube]

Changelog
- Much smoother performance
- Eliminated loading 'hitch' when entering new rooms
- Added post effects (TXAA, SSAO, bloom, color grading, automatic eye exposure adjustment)
- Fixed problem with doorways not always aligning perfectly
- Moved an awkward pipe obstacle
- Fixed a problem with shell casings going to sleep in midair
- Converted from Unityscript to C#
- Updated from Unity 2012 to 2019

Bugs
If you find any bugs, please email a full description along with your system specs to bugs@wolfire.com

Discord
If you'd like to get even more involved in our community you can join our Discord server here!
